title: Act 1 - Segment 5: Pokémon Tower to Fuchsia City (Soul Badge)
synopsis: Unmask the haunted spirits of Pokémon Tower with the Silph Scope, awaken sleeping Snorlax with the Poké Flute, traverse Cycling Road and Silence Bridge, retrieve the Surfboard and Warden's Gold Teeth in the Safari Zone, and defeat Ninja Master Koga in a strict 4v4 duel under the Level 42 Hard Mode cap.
